title: Union Bank and Dulles financing the Nazis
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Union Bank and Dulles financing the Nazis, about 1920s-1930s at Germany, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.difference: Told by Sheehan himself about 'American industrialists' wanting Hitler to set up a fascist government, without naming Union Bank or Dulles.
tellings.link_reason: Sheehan's claim that American financiers funded the Nazis before the war matches the stored theory that Union Bank and Dulles financed the Nazis. In context it is the same Brown Brothers Harriman financing story.

as_told.title: Dulles brothers funded the rise of the Nazis

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that an American bank called the Union Bank funded the Nazis in Germany before the Second World War. He adds that he thinks the American Allen Dulles also took part in financing them, and that Dulles was stationed somewhere like Norway. He brings it up as part of a wider story about powerful insiders and hidden history.
